objective: Establish whether a European source supports a genuine daily, disaggregated, non-regulated physical-industrial BMA campaign before downloading a history or fitting a model.
excluded_outcomes: assessed or index prices represented as raw transactions

authority_boundary.VPS_use: only after access, licence, custody path and user authority are resolved

minimum_probe.preferred: remote schema plus smallest contractually permitted sample
minimum_probe.purpose: reduce access, semantics, coverage and licence uncertainty

gates: one row per event or lot with native timestamp
final sold, unsold and cancelled state distinguishable
final price and currency present; taxes and commissions separable or explicitly unavailable
quantity, unit, category and physical attributes identifiable
physical location and delivery or collection terms identifiable where applicable
revisions, duplicates and late arrivals observable or documented
actual daily density and historical depth measurable by jurisdiction
licence permits modelling, audit and persistence of declared derivatives
outcomes are neither regulated nor administered prices
minimal export can be processed without unnecessary local raw persistence

terminal_states.PASS: All critical semantics, coverage, licence and custody gates pass; freeze a source-specific scientific experiment before opening further outcomes.
terminal_states.FAIL: Observed source contract cannot support the claimed daily industrial jurisdiction.
terminal_states.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Access could not be obtained; this is not evidence of no market activity.
terminal_states.PARTNERSHIP_REQUIRED: Potentially valid internal data exists but contractual access remains unresolved.
